description: Choke valve stiction on Well W-12: valve fails to respond to setpoint changes, causing wellhead pressure build-up and a flow rate drop
Export pump mechanical seal wear: vibration ramps up over several hours with a corresponding dip in discharge pressure
Separator level control valve stuck: level oscillates outside normal band, disturbing separator pressure
Wellhead temperature sensor failure on Well W-20: reading freezes (flatlines) for the duration of the fault
Gas compressor surge event: vibration spikes and oscillates with correlated discharge pressure swings
Downstream export pipeline blockage: pipeline pressure ramps upward, back-propagating into pump discharge pressure
Choke trim erosion on Well W-15: flow rate gradually increases beyond the expected response for the commanded choke position
Brief power dip trips the export pump: speed collapses to near zero then recovers, with a transient suction pressure build-up
Tank farm export valve fault: tank level climbs continuously toward high-high instead of holding around its normal setpoint
Wellhead pressure gauge failure on Well W-25: reading freezes (flatlines) for the duration of the fault
